title: This week’s gift card offers with Flybuys and Everyday Rewards
body:
Weekly supermarket gift card offers are one of the easiest ways to earn bonus frequent flyer points at a lower cost. Even if you don’t have a rewards points-earning credit card, gift card offers could easily net you thousands of bonus points on things you would buy anyway.
Popular offers include 20x Flybuys or Everyday Rewards points on Apple gift cards, Uber gift cards, Ultimate gift cards and more. Here are the latest weekly gift card offers for 2026.
Week 46: supermarket gift card offers
Offer Period: 28 October to 03 November 2026
2,000 bonus Flybuys points on $100/$250 Coles Mastercard gift cards at Coles
This week, earn a fixed 2,000 bonus Flybuys points (that’s 1,000 Velocity Points when transferred) on $100 and $250 Coles Mastercard gift cards. This offer excludes the $50 gift card. Note that purchase fees apply.
The purple $100 gift cards are the most popular as you get the best value on points overall, but stock can be quite hard to find due to their popularity.
A limit of 5 gift cards per Flybuys account.
$5 purchase fee for the $100 gift card. $7 purchase fee for the $250 gift card.
See the Coles catalogue for more information.
20x Everyday Rewards points on Apple gift cards at Woolworths
This week, earn 20x bonus Everyday Rewards points (that’s 10 Qantas Points per dollar) on all denominations of Apple gift cards. You can use this offer to purchase the new iPhone series.
For example, if your budget stretches to the iPhone Duo (lucky you), you could purchase 7x $500 gift cards and 1x $99 gift card using the variable load card. You’d earn at least 35,990 Qantas Points for the $3,599 purchase, along with any points earned on your credit or debit card.
There have been reports of tampered Apple gift cards, so be sure to inspect cards carefully before purchase and redeem them as soon as possible.
For all cards, limit of 10 cards per day, per member.
See the Woolworths catalogue for more information.
Week 45: supermarket gift card offers
Offer Period: 4 to 10 November 2026
20x bonus points on Apple gift cards at Coles
This week, earn 20x Flybuys points on Apple gift cards (that’s 10x Velocity Points per dollar spent). You can use this offer to purchase the new iPhone series.
For example, if your budget stretches to the iPhone Duo (lucky you), you could purchase 7x $500 gift cards and 1x $99 gift card using the variable load card, over two days or two accounts (e.g. ask a friend or partner to purchase with you). You’d earn at least 35,990 Velocity Points for the $3,599 purchase, along with any points earned on your credit or debit card.
There have been reports of tampered Apple gift cards, so be sure to inspect cards carefully before purchase and redeem them as soon as possible.
A limit of 5 gift cards per customer, per day.
See the Coles catalogue for more information.
10% off selected gift cards at Woolworths
This week, save 10% on Dymocks, Event Cinemas, Nintendo eShop and Google Play gift cards. There’s no bonus points offer for now.
For all cards, limit of 10 cards per day, per member.
See the Woolworths catalogue for more information.
